name: Mini Doubt Towerman Hen
original_name: ミニダウト タワマン編
source: The protagonist got engaged to a famous news announcer, but suddenly he cancelled their engagement! She's now left alone to live in the luxurious apartment they bought to live in after the wedding, but she'll meet six women and men... and one of them may be her partner for life!
translation: 主角与一位著名新闻播音员订婚，但他突然取消了订婚！现在，她独自一人住在他们结婚后购买的豪华公寓里，但她将遇到六位女性和男性……其中一位可能会成为她的终身伴侣！
